summary: A mixed morning dominated by Reliance's capital markets activity and India's record FDI achievement, alongside key regulatory developments in judicial governance and fintech policy.

bullets.text: Reliance lines up $1 billion bond sale, its second offering in three weeks, signaling continued capital market access.
India recorded highest-ever FDI of $94.53 billion in FY26; total inflows since 2014 reach $843 billion.
FM Sitharaman states UPI MDR decision completely professional, taken jointly by NPCI and payment banks, no external pressure.
Supreme Court seeks NIA response to bail plea of man accused of links to Dawood Ibrahim's gang.
India's QSRs implement Rs 99 price point to attract more customers and rethink value strategy.
